Scoring: +30 small (<25) and founder-led; +8 partial startup credit (startup-priced readiness engagements per third-party roundups, but their own site never mentions startups and leans ALTA/title-insurance, HIPAA, PCI generalist); +5 partial GRC credit (Tentacle co-marketing shows the principals will partner with compliance software, but no Vanta/Drata/Secureframe/Thoropass presence); +0 AWS (no cloud signals anywhere); +10 direct founder contact (Raja's LinkedIn plus public firm phone/email); +0 age (founded 2014-15, outside the 8-year window). The Tentacle precedent is the real hook: they have already run exactly the co-marketing motion LoxeAI wants, so pitch a like-for-like referral arrangement where a validated scan shortens their $12K-$28K Type 1 readiness engagements. Do not assume AWS fluency — lead with a guided sandbox demo.
pitch_note: Hi Raja — I saw Oread's Tentacle partnership, so you clearly believe SOC 2 goes smoother when evidence is organized before the engagement starts. We built LoxeAI, an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner for lean startups; I'd love 30 minutes to have you run it against a sandbox AWS account and tear the findings apart from an auditor's perspective. If it holds up, the motion mirrors your Tentacle play: when a pre-audit startup isn't ready, you tell them 'run this scan first — it gets you about 80% of the way,' and they arrive at your Type 1 clean, faster, and cheaper to serve.
